title: Sunday · the seawall, April
logline: The seawall in April rain, the bay beyond, one crow. The watercolor is good now and the strip knows it and doesn't say.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the seawall's long curve in rain, the bay flat beyond it, main street's backs on the left. A crow on the wall.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, a long curving concrete seawall in spring rain with a flat bay beyond and a crow perched on it, the watercolor controlled and confident, no words

panels.name: Wall

panels.composition: Tier 2: the crow, close, wet, looking at the painter.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, a wet crow on a concrete wall looking directly at the viewer, no words

panels.name: Crow

panels.composition: Tier 3: the bay, and the ridge behind it, faint, with the first hint of the glow — barely a warmth in the gray. Held.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, a flat gray bay with a forested ridge behind it and a barely perceptible warm tone above the trees, no words
image.notes: The glow's first appearance in a Sunday, three years before 'Lanes.' Barely there.

panels.name: Bay

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: The glow, first hinted. A crow.
